title: The watchdog's “waits for the owner” question: an item handed back to the session that owns it, or an ask of another session, is not a wait on the owner; the same ask addressed to the owner is
note: Live case: a result reported that a to-do item was returned to the session that had set it (“she asked me to close the item, but only she can close it, so I returned it to her”); the model read “only she can” as the owner, and the owner got a to-do “close the item”. Texts are made up and neutral. Input = the language line + the SESSIONS block the watchdog adds when the result names sessions of the hub (⟦SESSIONS⟧, absent before) + the end of the result (no open cards). The last four turns are the neighbors that must stay a wait on the owner.

turns.input:
Owner's language: English.
⟦SESSIONS⟧The link https://example.com is already in the profile @example.shop — that is item t:302 of the session maps. She asked me to close the item itself, but only she can close it, so I returned it to her.

Owner's language: English.
⟦SESSIONS⟧Item 14 is the session maps' item. They asked me to close it, but only they can close it, so I handed it back to them.

Owner's language: English.
⟦SESSIONS⟧Asked the session maps to close its item 14: the link is already in place, and only the author of an item can close it. Close item 14, maps — that is the whole message I sent.

Owner's language: English.
Only the release agent can publish the build, so I passed it the branch and the notes. The tests are green, the page is checked on a phone.

Owner's language: English.
⟦SESSIONS⟧Handed the layout back to the session maps: only it can rebuild it. From you I need the bank sign-in: the statement is behind it and only you can sign in — sign in and write me “done”.

Owner's language: English.
The contract draft is ready and sent to the lawyer. She answered that only you can sign it: sign the PDF and send it back to me.

Owner's language: English.
⟦SESSIONS⟧The session sales returned the price list to me: they can't choose between the two layouts, only you can. Which one do we take, A or B?

Owner's language: English.
⟦SESSIONS⟧Item 14 went back to the session sales. Separately, the accountant called: she waits for your signature on the tax form today — sign it and send me the scan.
